hypothesis: hypothesis.md: established trend, first adverse 3x3 DMA close crossing, return, second adverse crossing predicts reversal sufficient to reach full gross 1R target
baseline: dma_cross_baseline with rolling 10-day structural stop; comparison only
entry_timeframe: 1d: naive stored calendar dates, Sunday merged into following Monday, built via 5m OHLC without interpolation
entry_rules: hypothesis.md; confirmed daily signals enter next observed daily open; period assignment by trading date; actual first source timestamp saved

exit_rules.stop: extreme from thrust start through signal +/- 0.1 Wilder ATR14
exit_rules.setup_expiry: N observed daily bars after first crossing
exit_rules.boundary: no force exit; exclude open trades from realized PF, disclose marked-to-market net R

final_period_prior_exposure: All evaluation eras have been used in previous project research; not an untouched out-of-sample claim. Current rule selection uses training only, then validation and one final disclosure with frozen code.

cost_and_fill_model.commission: 0; fail if metadata active commission is nonzero
cost_and_fill_model.price_basis: OHLC stored price, bid/ask origin not verified; roundtrip cost deducted from P/L
cost_and_fill_model.intraday_path: daily stop first if both barriers touched; adverse stop gap at open, favorable target gap capped at target
cost_and_fill_model.risk_ratio: gross price distances 1:1, net profit after fees below 1R and gaps can lose beyond 1R
cost_and_fill_model.limitations: not actual broker execution or swap; daily multi-day holding costs remain unverified

position_sizing_and_currency: one position per symbol; each trade normalized by initial price risk to 1R; no currency-converted account return, no compounding or position sizing advice

acceptance_gates.baseline_comparison: training only, report differences; no baseline candidate adoption
acceptance_gates.selection: independent candidate train pass -> validation pass plus joint profitable-symbol gate -> save selection before candidate final confirmation; at most two final confirmations
acceptance_gates.failure_stop: no passing candidates ends experiment without further search or later-period outcome disclosure
acceptance_gates.boundary_sensitivity: report metrics with open positions marked closed at last observed close separately, not used for formal gate

cross_symbol_rule: all 15 equal-risk symbol summaries; no cherry-picked pair adoption; train+validation profitable symbols >=10, final >=8 in each cost case
code_identifier: scripts/research_dinapoli_3x3_daily.py; actual code/protocol/source SHA256 saved in run metadata before simulations
